title: Build stress test harness — fixtures, validators, instrumentation
description: Create reusable test harness for L4/L5 stress tests: deterministic mock-agent fixtures, multi-round/multi-step scenario builders, timeout guards, state validators, and concurrent-session helpers. The harness should be usable by both TASK-003 (L4) and TASK-004 (L5) without duplication.
action: Create `src-tauri/bin/sidecar/workflow/__tests__/harness/stress-harness.js` exporting: (1) `createMockContainer({responses, latency})` returning a ServiceContainer-shaped object whose getAgent(type, opts) returns an agent with deterministic .generate(prompt) → responses[type]; (2) `createTempSessionRoot()` returning a unique tmp dir under os.tmpdir() with auto-cleanup; (3) `withTimeout(promise, ms, label)` rejecting with `TimeoutError(label)` after ms; (4) `validateNoUnhandledRejections()` installing a `process.on('unhandledRejection')` listener returning {pass, errors}; (5) `assertSessionState(sessionMgr, sessionId, expectedShape)` asserting required keys exist on the persisted state. Also create `__tests__/harness/scenarios.js` exporting `l4SequentialRounds(n)`, `l5ThreeStepChain()`, `concurrentL4Sessions(count)`.

convergence.definition_of_done: Harness is import-able and its self-test passes; TASK-003 and TASK-004 can build on it without modifying internals.

files.change: Export createMockContainer, createTempSessionRoot, withTimeout, validateNoUnhandledRejections, assertSessionState
Smoke test that each export functions correctly on its own (no L4/L5 yet)

implementation: createMockContainer({responses, latency=0}): return { getAgent(type, opts){ return { generate: async (prompt)=>{ if(latency) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,latency)); return responses[type] ?? `mock-${type}-response`; } }; } }

createTempSessionRoot(): const dir = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `niko-stress-${randomUUID()}`); fs.mkdirSync(dir, {recursive:true}); return { path: dir, cleanup: ()=>fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true}) };
withTimeout(promise, ms, label): return Promise.race([promise, new Promise((_,rej)=>setTimeout(()=>rej(new Error(`Timeout: ${label} after ${ms}ms`)), ms))]);

validateNoUnhandledRejections(): const errors=[]; const handler=(r)=>errors.push(r); process.on('unhandledRejection',handler); return { stop(){ process.off('unhandledRejection',handler); return {pass:errors.length===0, errors}; } };

assertSessionState(sessionMgr, sessionId, expectedShape): const stateStr = sessionMgr.read(sessionId, ContentType.STATE); const state = JSON.parse(stateStr||'{}'); for(const k of Object.keys(expectedShape)) { if(!(k in state)) throw new Error(`Missing key ${k}`); }
l4SequentialRounds(n): return n state objects {user_request: `topic-${i}`, context: i>0 ? `round-${i-1}-output` : ''} for sequential L4.execute() invocations
l5ThreeStepChain(): return state object {user_request: 'analyze plan execute', domain: 'novel', session_id: <new-uuid>}
concurrentL4Sessions(count): return count state objects with separate session_ids targeting same sessionRoot
Write stress-harness.test.js: test each export's contract (createMockContainer.getAgent returns object with generate, withTimeout rejects after ms, etc.)
